observations: AgentCliBackend._agent_io_log_path returns <project_root>/events.jsonl whenever a project usage context exists; without project context it can return ARGUS_SKILL_AGENT_IO_LOG or <working_dir>/.argus/events.jsonl.
execute() resolves that log_path before constructing the per-call context and passes it to AgentIOLogger.start_call.
spawn_and_finish() and log_start_record() call backend._log_agent_io(ctx.log_path, ...) for canonical agent.io start/error/complete records.
AgentCliBackend._log_agent_io delegates to AgentIOLogger.log; AgentIOLogger.log normalizes/redacts then calls _jsonl_append(path, row, self.io_log_lock).
_jsonl_append serializes only through an instance-local threading.Lock and opens the target path in append mode; no process-shared events.lock authority is used in this exact writer path.
In full mode, the raw provider transcript is written separately to sibling agent_io.jsonl through raw_transcript_path; this is a bounded debug artifact and is not the canonical events.jsonl path.
